project_type: Graph Neural Network Based Parking Prediction System

team_members.name: Chiranjeevi Veluri
team_members.role: Graph Construction, Feature Engineering, Prediction Workflow

project_description: This project predicts future parking occupancy using Graph Neural Networks (GNN) and Melbourne parking sensor data. The system constructs a graph where parking bays are represented as nodes and nearby bays are connected using spatial distance. Temporal and spatial features are used to forecast parking availability for selected Melbourne areas.

files.purpose: Creates graph structure using parking bays and spatial edges.
Performs feature engineering and forecasting label generation.
Prepares tensors and graph connectivity for model training.
Trains and evaluates the Graph Neural Network model.
Displays graph visualization of prediction outputs.
Allows users to select Melbourne suburbs for prediction.

workflow: Construct graph using parking bay locations
Generate node features and forecasting labels
future_improvements: Improve model accuracy using advanced GNN architectures
conclusion: The project demonstrates how Graph Neural Networks can be applied to smart city parking prediction problems using spatial and temporal data. The developed system successfully integrates graph construction, machine learning, prediction workflows, and visualization into a unified intelligent parking forecasting solution.
